# Filter for competitions after the 1999 European Junior Championships
# First, find the year of the 1999 European Junior Championships
euro_junior_1999_year = df[df['Competition'] == 'European Junior Championships']['Year'].iloc[0]
# Then filter for competitions after that year
after_1999 = df[df['Year'] > euro_junior_1999_year]
# Sort by Year to get the next competition(s)
after_1999_sorted = after_1999.sort_values('Year')
# Get the minimum year after 1999
next_year = after_1999_sorted['Year'].min()
# Filter for rows with that year
next_competitions = after_1999_sorted[after_1999_sorted['Year'] == next_year]
# Get the Competition values
competition_names = next_competitions['Competition'].tolist()
# Since the question is singular and we expect one competition, we take the first one.
# But note: there might be multiple competitions in the same year. However, in this dataset, there is only one in 2000.
answer = competition_names[0]
